# Pixenox

> Pixenox Solutions Pvt Ltd is an AI engineering company headquartered in India. We operate three engineering disciplines: **AI Systems Engineering** (autonomous multi-agent systems, decision intelligence, AI infrastructure), **Enterprise Intelligence Engineering** (unified data platforms, systems integration, cloud infrastructure), and **AI Visibility** (Generative Engine Optimization / GEO, Answer Engine Optimization / AEO, structured data engineering, AI citation monitoring). See llms-full.txt for expanded definitions, case studies, FAQs, and technical context.

## Core Engineering Disciplines

- [AI Systems Engineering](https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-systems): Design, build, and operate autonomous AI infrastructure — multi-agent orchestration, decision intelligence engines, and execution systems that run enterprise workflows in production.
- [Enterprise Intelligence Engineering](https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/enterprise-intelligence-engineering): Integrate ERP, CRM, cloud, and document systems into one governed data layer with business intelligence, workflow automation, and data infrastructure engineering.
- [AI Visibility — Generative Engine Optimization](https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-visibility): Structure a brand's data, entity signals, and content so AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) can identify and cite it. GEO/AEO strategy, structured data engineering, knowledge graph engineering, and AI citation monitoring.

## Key Definitions

- **AI Systems Engineering**: The discipline of designing autonomous AI infrastructure — multi-agent orchestration, decision intelligence, and execution systems — that runs enterprise workflows with reduced manual intervention.
- **Enterprise Intelligence Engineering**: The discipline of integrating an organization's ERP, CRM, cloud, and document systems into one governed data layer, without replacing the underlying software.
- **AI Visibility**: The discipline of structuring a brand's data, entity signals, and content so that AI answer engines can identify and cite it in generated answers.
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: Optimizing content and entity data to be extracted and cited inside AI-generated answers, as distinct from SEO which optimizes to rank a clickable link.
- **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**: Structuring content to be selected as the direct answer in AI-powered search and voice interfaces.
